csv_project_name: Design Scv Division Street Realignment & Intersection Impr
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Palmdale seeks a qualified consultant to provide professional civil and traffic engineering design services, as well as public outreach services for the PN 946-Division Street Realignment & Intersection Improvement from Avenue Q to Palmdale Boulevard. This project involves the realignment of Division Street from East Palmdale Boulevard to West Avenue Q. The road will be realigned for the future development of adjacent property. The scope of the work for the design of the realignment includes but not limited to: survey, utility research, drainage & hydrology studies, traffic impact analysis, signal optimization, geotechnical analysis, greenbelt design, grading, design alternatives, Caltrans encroachment permit, and final design plans specifications and construction estimate, public outreach, and construction engineering support.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Traffic Design Engineering
